headline.en: Claret raises €575m for fourth European growth debt fund
headline.zh: Claret为第四只欧洲成长债基金募集5.75亿欧元

summary.en: Claret Capital Partners has raised €575m for its fourth European growth debt fund, Claret European Growth Capital Fund IV, at final close. The fund surpassed its €500m target and has already invested 32 per cent of capital across 27 venture and growth companies.
summary.zh: Claret Capital Partners为其第四只欧洲成长债基金Claret European Growth Capital Fund IV完成最终募集，规模5.75亿欧元。该基金超出5亿欧元的目标，并已将32%的资金投资于27家风险投资和成长型企业。

headline.en: KBRA reports rising non-accruals as BDC credit stress emerges
headline.zh: KBRA报告称BDC信贷压力显现，非应计投资上升

summary.en: Ratings agency KBRA said headwinds have become increasingly evident in business development companies, with selective credit issues more prevalent and non-accrual investments increasing. Credit stress became more visible in the second quarter of 2026, particularly among a limited set of borrowers and managers.
summary.zh: 评级机构KBRA表示，业务发展公司（BDC）面临的阻力已“日益明显”，选择性信贷问题更加普遍，非应计投资有所增加。2026年第二季度信贷压力更加明显，尤其集中在有限的一组借款人和管理人。
